scenarios.criterion: Cinzel (400, 700) and Inter (400, 600) MUST load from the app's own origin, through @fontsource/cinzel and @fontsource/inter pinned to exact versions, and src/styles.css MUST have no @import from another origin.
scenarios.name: Fonts load from the application's own origin with exact-pinned packages
given: The application serves its own stylesheet and font packages
then: Cinzel and Inter font files are requested only from the app's own origin
src/styles.css contains no @import pointing at another origin
package.json pins @fontsource/cinzel and @fontsource/inter to exact versions with no ^ or ~

scenarios.criterion: tests/reagent-map-globe.spec.ts MUST drop PRE_EXISTING_OFF_ORIGIN_HOSTS and the code that skips those hosts, and its no-request test MUST pass with no exception.
scenarios.name: No-request test passes without any off-origin host exception
given: tests/reagent-map-globe.spec.ts no longer defines PRE_EXISTING_OFF_ORIGIN_HOSTS or any host-skipping logic
then: The test passes with no exception raised
No request to any off-origin host is observed or excused

scenarios.criterion: The no-request test MUST fail when the old cross-origin @import is restored. Record the failing output in the delivery record.
scenarios.name: No-request test fails if the cross-origin font import returns
given: The old cross-origin Google Fonts @import is temporarily restored in styles.css
then: The test fails
The failing output is captured and recorded in the delivery record under docs/features/local-fonts/
The @import is reverted afterward so the suite returns to green

scenarios.criterion: A page opened in the runner image MUST still render headings in Cinzel and body text in Inter, checked in tests/local-fonts.spec.ts with document.fonts.load at the exact weight, never document.fonts.check.
scenarios.name: Headings render in Cinzel and body text renders in Inter at the correct weights
given: A page is opened in the runner image
when: tests/local-fonts.spec.ts checks the fonts in use via document.fonts.load
then: document.fonts.load confirms a Cinzel face loaded at weight 400 and at weight 700
document.fonts.load confirms an Inter face loaded at weight 400 and at weight 600
The test never calls document.fonts.check

scenarios.criterion: A page opened in the runner image MUST still render headings in Cinzel and body text in Inter, checked in tests/local-fonts.spec.ts with document.fonts.load at the exact weight, never document.fonts.check.
scenarios.name: Removing all self-hosted font imports is caught by the font test
given: All four @fontsource imports are temporarily removed from main.ts
then: The test fails because document.fonts.load resolves no matching face for each family/weight pair
The failing output is recorded in the delivery record
The imports are reverted afterward

scenarios.criterion: A page opened in the runner image MUST still render headings in Cinzel and body text in Inter, checked in tests/local-fonts.spec.ts with document.fonts.load at the exact weight, never document.fonts.check.
scenarios.name: Removing only the Inter 600 import is caught by weight, not by document.fonts.check
given: Only the @fontsource/inter/600.css import is temporarily removed from main.ts
then: The test fails because the resolved Inter FontFace's weight does not match 600
The failure is detected even though document.fonts.check would have returned true for this case
The failing output is recorded in the delivery record
The import is reverted afterward

scenarios.criterion: docs/testing-cesium.md's Google Fonts entry under "Known gaps" MUST be gone, and the file MUST still follow .claude/rules/writing-style.md.
scenarios.name: Documentation no longer lists Google Fonts as a known gap
given: docs/testing-cesium.md previously listed Google Fonts under its "Known gaps" section
then: The Google Fonts entry is removed from "Known gaps"
The rest of docs/testing-cesium.md still follows the Simplified Technical English rules in .claude/rules/writing-style.md

scenarios.criterion: scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh and scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh --ubi9 MUST both pass.
scenarios.name: The UI suite passes in both the debian and ubi9 runner images
then: Both runs pass
tests/reagent-map-globe.spec.ts's no-request test and tests/local-fonts.spec.ts pass in both runs

scenarios.criterion: Every new or changed function MUST have cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line MUST be covered by a test that can fail, and no file outside scope.paths MUST change (the run's own delivery record under docs/features/local-fonts/ excepted).
scenarios.name: The change stays within complexity, coverage, and file-scope budgets
given: The delivered change set for local-fonts
when: Complexity, test coverage, and file scope are checked
then: Every new or changed function has cyclomatic complexity below 7
Every changed line is covered by a test that can fail
No file outside scope.paths changed, except the delivery record under docs/features/local-fonts/
